jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(5)(D) inventory: River Valleys Unified School District, a unified union district in the Windham Central Supervisory Union (member towns: Dover, Wardsboro). Operates PK-6 in both towns; tuitions grades 7-12.
River Valleys Unified School District (official site).

board.post_note: River Valleys USD: six directors, residency allocated three Dover / three Wardsboro, elected by both towns' voters on Australian ballot since the 2023 model change (modified at-large, 16 V.S.A. section 730(a)(2) pattern).

sources.note: Windham Central SU RVUSD Board Members page (official): Werner (Chair) expiry 2029; Rideout (Vice-Chair) 2029; Boerem (Clerk) 2027; Porter 2028; Campbell 2029; Block 2028. The district's own board page: "Our Board of School Directors consists of six members, three from Dover and three from Wardsboro... A new voting model was adopted in 2023... Residents of both towns are now able to cast ballots for candidates from each town" -- modified at-large. FLAGS carried as published: per-member towns are not published on either page (the 3+3 split cannot be attributed member-by-member), and the published expiries distribute 1/2/3 across 2027/2028/2029 against the described 2-per-year stagger -- carried as printed, not smoothed. Resolving document: the district's 2026 annual meeting warning / annual report.
